'''With a Little Help From Hitmonchan''' (Japanese: '''VS エビワラー''' ''VS Hitmonchan''), titled '''VS Hitmonchan''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 450th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the ninth chapter of the {{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}.

It is subtitled '''Gathering of the Four Executives!''' (Japanese: '''集合４将軍！''' ''The Four Generals Assemble!'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''The Four Executives Together''' in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
{{adv|Crystal}} continues her battle against [[Ariana]]. When Ariana's {{p|Murkrow}} {{m|Fly|flies}} into the air, Crystal's [[Monlee]] manages to strike it with a {{m|Bullet Punch}}. Ariana says that Crystal is so desperate because {{adv|Silver}} had left the battle, but Crystal strongly denies it. Ariana's {{p|Arbok}} defeats Crystal's [[Bonee]], and her Murkrow takes down Monlee. Then, Ariana reveals the roles of the four [[Team Rocket]] {{tc|Executive}}s: [[Ariana]] eradicates obstacles that get in their way, [[Petrel]] sneaks into various locations in disguise to find the [[Plate]]s, [[Proton]] has to locate the [[Sinjoh Ruins]] by using critical thinking, and [[Archer]] is the group's leader in obtaining {{adv|Arceus}}.

Upon saying this, Petrel, Proton, and Archer arrive on the scene. Archer reveals that Arceus is already summoned, and points to it. Crystal looks at it, shaking in terror. Archer says it was found in [[Sinnoh|a far-off land]] at [[Hall of Origin|the end of a long road]], but thinks they would not believe the place's name or where it exists, so he decides to not say them. More importantly, Arceus has come down to the world because all of the [[Plate]]s are gathered in [[Johto]].

However, Crystal feels as if Arceus is different from the other {{pkmn2|Legendary}} and [[Mythical Pokémon]] she has met because of how intense Arceus seems to be. Based on what Archer said about where Arceus came from, she concludes that Arceus doesn't belong to anyone yet. She then kicks a [[Level Ball]] at Arceus.

==Major events==
* [[Ariana]] reveals the role of each {{tc|Executive}}.
* {{adv|Crystal}} is nearly defeated before {{adv|Arceus}} appears before her.
* Crystal attempts to [[Caught Pokémon|capture]] Arceus.
